about: Plain scalars, in YAML text: the vectors of schema-vectors.json are JSON and never meet the typing of the strict profile (bootstrap-file.md Format, rule 4), where an unquoted 84 or 1e3 is a number, 0x1f and 010 and 1_000 are strings, and only null, ~ and an empty value are null. Each case is read by the strict YAML reader of the language and its schema applied to what it reads, in Go (kits/go/signedconfig) and in Rust (actors/store): the verdict and the words must be the case's. The cases are the ones a hand-written slot, thumbprint, duration or number meets.
